{{Quote|That business on Cato Neimoidia doesn't... doesn't count.|Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="Episode 3">{{Film|III}}</ref>}}
The oldest of the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Purse world/Legends|purse worlds]], '''Cato Neimoidia''' was the location of [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray's]] secret [[Nute Gunray's citadel|redoubt]]. The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was near the Neimoidian homeworld of [[Neimoidia/Legends|Neimoidia]], also in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region.

Only the richest of the Neimoidians were allowed to live on the planet. Their treasures were protected in vaults located in difficult landscape and protected by [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]]. The cities of Cato Neimoidia were built on large [[Bridge city/Legends|bridges]] spanning massive rock arches.

Cato Neimoidia featured vast forests rich in flora and fauna. Notable species included the [[Neimoidian kreehawk/Legends|Neimoidian kreehawk]], a dangerous but beautiful avian found in some aviaries.

==History==
{{Quote|This is hardly your planet anymore&mdash;not since you signed it over to the Banking Clan in return for a stake in this new droid foundry.|Senator Rush Clovis, to Senator Lott Dod|<ref name="Senate Spy">{{TCW|Senate Spy}}</ref>}}
===Early history===
[[File:CNCityBridges-SS.png|thumb|left|240px|Three [[Bridge city/Legends|bridge cities]] of Cato Neimoidia]]
Cato Neimoidia was one of many worlds colonized by the Neimoidians early during the [[Old Republic era]], joining the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] sometime between [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]] and [[22,000 BBY/Legends|22,000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />

The wealthiest and most resource-rich colony worlds were known as "purse worlds" that served as administrative posts ruling their own set of colonies. These purse worlds were the only colonies allowed to carry the name of Neimoidia. Other Neimoidian purse worlds include [[Deko Neimoidia/Legends|Deko Neimoidia]] and [[Koru Neimoidia/Legends|Koru Neimoidia]], both were nearby in the same region of the Galaxy. Cato Neimoidia was the oldest purse world<ref name="CotG" /> and may have been one of the earliest Neimoidian colonies.

===Cold War===
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Republic [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Theron Shan]] was rumored to have had enemies in the corporate dens of Cato Neimoidia.<ref name="Lost Suns 3">[[The Old Republic — The Lost Suns 3|''The Old Republic — The Lost Suns'' 3]]</ref>

===Rise of the Empire===
{{Quote|This planet is vital to the Separatist movement...A victory here could turn the tide of war!|Jedi Master Ferroda|<ref name="Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron">''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron]]''</ref>}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it was a key member of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and was defended by the [[Neimoidian Home Defense Legion/Legends|Neimoidian Home Defense Legions]].

The [[Battle of Jorra]] was fought on Cato Neimoidia.<ref name="Chronicles">''[[Chronicles of the Gatekeeper]]''</ref> [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] undertook a [[Mission to Cato Neimoidia/Legends|mission to Cato Neimoidia]].<ref name="SS">{{TCW|Senate Spy}}</ref> Skywalker and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] later led their forces in the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] to [[Defense of Cato Neimoidia/Legends|defend]] Cato Neimoidia from Separatist invasion, yet the Jedi were called away due to the [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar/Legends|Bombing of the Jedi Temple Hangar]].<ref name="Sabotage">{{TCW|Sabotage (episode)}}</ref> By the end of the war, Cato Neimoidia was described as the "heart of the Separatist movement" by [[X2]].<ref name="Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Siege of Cato Neimoidia|launched an attack]] on the redoubt, led by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and Skywalker, as well as [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]], to find [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] and bring him to justice. Although Gunray escaped, he left behind hoards of valuables, all of which was captured by the Republic. In addition to this, he also left behind the [[Mechno-chair/Legends|mechno-chair]] he used to contact the other Separatist leaders and [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]].

[[File:CatoNeimoidiaconcept.jpg|thumb|left|220px|A [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] room containing many valuables]]
The bridge cities persisted in resisting the Republic, leading to a [[Battle of Cato Neimoidia/Legends|fierce aerial battle]] in which [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] was shot down by his own [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilots]] shortly after [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] was enacted by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], who declared himself [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] soon afterwards. Also, the Jedi clones [[X1]] and X2 fought in the battle, and [[X2]] killed [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ferroda]] in Gunray's palace for attacking his comrades in self-defense, though he later turned against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] after believing that what the newly founded Empire did on Cato Neimoidia was wrong.

After Anakin Skywalker ended the Clone Wars with the [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|massacre]] of the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], including Nute Gunray. Acting Viceroy [[Sentepeth Findos]], on [[Neimoidia/Legends|Neimoidia]] [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|resisted]] for a [[Battle on Neimoidia/Legends|brief moment]] but was forced by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] to sign a [[Imperial–Trade Federation treaty|peace treaty]] with the Empire a few days after the Clone Wars ended and almost immediately after the Battle of Neimoidia had concluded, the Battle of Cato Neimoidia had ended as well, in favor of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. This gave all of the Federation's resources to Palpatine's disposal to help him build the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy's]] new regime, which had made the Trade Federation a puppet government.

===Imperial Era===
{{Quote|Cato Neimoidia was offered willingly to Emperor Palpatine, who graciously took this jewel little planet under his protection. Since then, Cato Neimoidia has thrived and prospered. Much, if not all of the credit for this, must be given to the leadership of our wise and benevolent leader, Baron Tarko.|Imperial propaganda on Cato Neimoidia|<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''</ref>}}
Months after the Clone Wars ended, agents of [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] infiltrated the palace of [[Darga Jiramma Mionne|Darga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] in the ruined capital city of [[Zarra/Legends|Zarra]] on Cato Neimoidia. They freed Darga's prisoner, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Denia]]. Before leaving the palace, the agents overheard [[Igren Demos|Darga's majordomo]] having a conversation with [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Valin Draco|Draco]]. Four months after the Republic's transformation into the Galactic Empire, Jedi [[Dass Jennir]] came to Cato Neimoidia looking for work.

===Galactic Civil War===
{{Quote|Troopers' lives are cheap, but that Neimoidian architecture is expensive.|Merillion Tarko|<ref name="Game">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Tarko-se.jpg|thumb|250px|Tarko-se during the early Galactic Civil War.]]
In [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], during the early [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the planet had been designated as a protectorate of the Empire and thus outfitted with an Imperial garrison led by [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Merillion Tarko]]. The Baron's iron rule over the planet, however, came to an end when a [[Subject 1138|clone]] of [[Galen Marek]] flew to Cato Neimoidia to rescue [[General/Legends|General]] [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]], resulting in the destruction of much of [[Tarko-se/Legends|Tarko-se]], its [[Tarko-se Arena|arena]], and the death of Tarko by being eaten by a [[Gorog (creature)|Gorog]] as well.

For nineteen years, the Trade Federation had continued to exist, until the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] was [[Dissolution of the Imperial Senate/Legends|dissolved]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], taking the Trade Federation with it shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. 

===Later history===
Located in [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] space as of [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]], Cato Neimoidia was conquered by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] in the run-up to their [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|capture]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. The forces that took the planet went on to [[Battle of Commenor (Yuuzhan Vong War)|attack]] [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]].<ref name="TEA" />
